title: If
help: Continues on 'then' if the condition is true, otherwise on 'else'.

title: For
help: Counts i from 'from' to 'to' (both included) in steps of 'step' and runs the blocks on 'each round' once for every i, then continues on 'done'. Wire i into a setting (a brightness, a position, a hue; Map range scales it). If 'from' is larger than 'to' it counts down. Put a Wait in the round to set its pace.

fields.name: start
fields.label: From
fields.help: The first i.

fields.name: end
fields.label: To
fields.help: The last i (included).

fields.name: step
fields.label: Step
fields.help: How much i changes each round.

title: While
help: Runs the blocks on 'each round' again and again while the condition is true (checked before every round), then continues on 'done'. With nothing wired and the condition ticked it runs for ever (until the engine is deactivated). 'round' counts 1, 2, 3 and can be wired into a setting. Put a Wait in the round to set its pace.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.help: Wire a condition here (Compare).

title: Number list
help: Numbers in order: positions to step through, brightness levels, waiting times. 'item' is the one at 'no.' (1 = the first; past the last it starts again), so a For's i goes through them; 'count' is how many there are (wire it into a For's 'to').

fields.name: index
fields.label: No.
fields.help: Which one 'item' is; 1 = the first.

title: Text list
help: Texts in order: lines to say, names to go through. 'item' is the one at 'no.' (1 = the first; past the last it starts again), so a For's i goes through them; 'count' is how many there are (wire it into a For's 'to').

fields.name: index
fields.label: No.
fields.help: Which one 'item' is; 1 = the first.

title: Colour list
help: Colours in order. 'list' feeds a setting that takes several colours; 'item' is the one at 'no.' (1 = the first; past the last it starts again), so a For's i goes through them; 'count' is how many there are (wire it into a For's 'to').

fields.name: index

title: Map range
help: Scales a number: in min..in max becomes out min..out max.

title: Colour from hue
help: Hue 0-360 (0 red, 120 green, 240 blue) and brightness 0-100 make a colour.
